method_notes.open_loop_llm: Open-loop DA-ELC keeps the DA-ELC tool chain: the LLM chooses selected_hotspot_id, update_mrsu_cache, and update_frsu_cache; QPPathPlanner plans the mRSU path; DemandAwareCooperativeCache rebuilds caches when update flags are enabled. Previous-round miss feedback and cache-fit residual feedback are hidden. Runtime caches are preserved when an RSU update flag is false, but cache lists are not exposed to the LLM prompt. Decision-time demand is regenerated independently from MovieLens training history only; no test-set requests are used before evaluation.
